objective: Deliver one short, public, browser-only PQ-12 test URL for iPad/iPhone that collects local performance evidence without touching active FAE state or requiring user setup.

frozen_workload.target_duration: short interactive run; no sustained stress loop
frozen_workload.material_policy: ephemeral local test material only; no real wallet, seed phrase, passphrase or FAE private key
frozen_workload.network_policy: no FAE RPC, no backend API, no submission to testnet/mainnet
frozen_workload.storage_policy: no persistent storage and no automatic result upload

packages.name: Authority and intensity freeze
packages.objective: Freeze scope so the test cannot grow into a stress benchmark or active-network test.
packages.gate: All authority/network/storage/intensity invariants are machine-readable before implementation.

packages.name: Light browser benchmark implementation
packages.objective: Build single-page Start -> progress -> results -> Copy Results workflow using the frozen workload.
packages.gate: No backend/RPC/storage/real wallet dependency; exactly the frozen ML-DSA workload.

packages.name: Public static delivery
packages.objective: Publish via Route A and automatically fall back to Route B/C only if needed.
packages.gate: Public HTTPS URL loads independently of the FAE testnet and exposes only the light test.

packages.name: Automated preflight
packages.objective: Validate mobile viewport, start/completion flow, no network submission, result rendering, and copy action before user testing.
packages.gate: Automated QA passes with no frontend/runtime error.

packages.name: Physical evidence handoff
packages.objective: User runs the page once on iPad first and returns copied JSON result.
packages.gate: Result includes device/browser context and measured values; no secret/private material.

stop_conditions: Do not add SLH-DSA to this light test.
